name: image-to-video-ai
title: 几秒钟内从定格画面到现场场景
description: Transform static images into fluid, animated video sequences with ClawHub's image-to-video-ai skill. Upload a photo and describe the motion you want — camera panning, subject movement, atmospheric effects — and the AI generates a polished video output. Ideal for content creators, marketers, and social media teams who need motion content without filming. Supports mp4, mov, avi, webm, and mkv output formats.
title_en: From Frozen Frame to Living Scene in Seconds
